summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. All three files are thin @proxy wrappers over scalar/pointer C signatures; no @cfunc body, no NRT refcount/meminfo/structref operations, and no struct-by-value or Record-return ABI paths are present here, so none of the MEM hazards (cfunc exception swallow/leak, refcount imbalance, sret/eightbyte repack, struct ABI) apply. The errmsg/expanded_sql lifetime concerns are caller responsibilities the bindings themselves model correctly. No findings.
